origin: Exact current Desktop Commander 31-tool discovery plus frozen 50-tool Hepta v4 contract and model-origin bounded acceptance receipts

terms.bounded: At least one limited demonstrated workflow; NOT full per-argument parity or universal ChatGPT approval.
terms.partial: Some functionality available, but one or more DC semantics missing.
terms.unimplemented: No dedicated Hepta equivalent or user-flow completion yet.
terms.vendor_specific: DC account/agent product function needs a truthful Hepta-specific retirement decision, not a fake vendor clone.

entries.limits: Hepta returns fixed configured host aliases/capability flags, not DC remote device enrollment.
DC account identity/billing is product-specific, not the host login identity.
entries.next_gate: Replace DC account access with Hepta-owned identity/entitlement reporting; no fake DC billing identity.

entries.limits: Only Hepta-owned durable jobs can be reconciled; no DC request call_id is adopted.
entries.next_gate: Prove equivalent reconnect/status for Hepta-owned model-origin asynchronous tool calls.

entries.limits: Lists Hepta durable jobs rather than DC background MCP call IDs.
entries.next_gate: Create truthful Hepta request-level async call history, separate from OS processes.

entries.limits: host_list and network_inspect do not measure target reachability/RTT.
entries.next_gate: Implement safe configured-host health/latency probe without user-supplied network destinations.

entries.limits: DC shutdown stops the DC agent, not the computer; not meaningful as a Hepta shell alias.
entries.next_gate: Qualify supported Hepta agent lifecycle maintenance with independent rescue before retiring DC.

entries.limits: Host capabilities and service state do not expose the full authenticated Hepta effective config.
entries.next_gate: Provide a redacted, read-only effective-config inspection that never returns credentials.

entries.limits: DC vendor application settings include blocklists and allowed directories; no arbitrary Hepta policy writer is exposed.
entries.next_gate: Use reviewed versioned Hepta administrator policy changes with rollback; do not clone a generic blocklist editor.

entries.limits: Different text/binary/document APIs; tested bounded real file reads and hashes.
Parallel per-path reads work, but no single atomic bounded multi-file result equivalent.
entries.next_gate: Implement a bounded multi-file read interface, per-path authorization and total-size budget.

entries.limits: Create/append/replace are fingerprint guarded; not every DC mode or arbitrary path combination.
One-page scratch PDF created through Hepta and DC; rich visual semantics remain unproven.
Private controller-workspace create-only semantics; no remote mkdir in this tool.
Native directory listing and filters exist but DC listing response/pagination and GUI semantics differ.
entries.next_gate: Qualify model-origin paginated directory listings and hidden/symlink handling.

entries.limits: Atomic no-overwrite same-filesystem controller moves; broader DC move semantics differ.
Hepta supports bounded synchronous content/glob search, not an independent cancellable search job.
entries.next_gate: Add a native bounded search lifecycle, explicit IDs, pagination and cancellation without a shell.

entries.limits: Range-based view pagination is not a stable continuation cursor for a live search.
entries.next_gate: Add stable search result cursor semantics bound to a fixed search snapshot.

entries.limits: No search job identity exists to cancel, unlike DC.
entries.next_gate: Implement cancellation of only the Hepta-created search identity.

entries.limits: No catalog of Hepta search jobs exists.
entries.next_gate: Expose bounded search-session discovery without exposing other users' work.

entries.limits: Regular file metadata with SHA256/version; DC broader directory metadata differs.
Version/line-hash aware editing of scratch text has model-origin evidence; XML edits separate.
Harmless normal-user shell pipeline and exact executable argv through durable jobs, not arbitrary commands.
Bounded byte-cursor native job and PTY output; model-origin real output checked on six hosts.
Only Hepta-owned PTY sessions; cannot retroactively adopt arbitrary DC buffers.
Only runtime-owned jobs or identity-checked disposable PIDs; no wildcard process groups.
Hepta-created terminals/jobs only; DC internal sessions cannot be enumerated or migrated wholesale.
entries.next_gate: Prove restart/reconnect history for Hepta-owned PTYs, and explicit DC session retirement.

entries.limits: Bounded actual host processes with UID/start identity; caller arguments intentionally omitted.
Only one start-identity pinned disposable external PID delivered a signal; not broad unrestricted kill.
DC subscription usage is provider data; Hepta cannot truthfully return DC billing percentages.
entries.next_gate: Define Hepta-specific redacted quota, audit and call-usage statistics from its own authority.

entries.limits: Native runtime audit exists, but no equivalent caller-scoped, redacted MCP tool-call history exposed.
entries.next_gate: Add scoped audit cursor and privacy/retention controls; distinguish tool calls from jobs.

entries.limits: DC vendor survey link has no meaning once replaced.
entries.next_gate: Provide Hepta-owned issue/report path if needed; no impersonation of DC feedback.

public_cloud_gateway: Independent OAuth/tenant/device product gate; not implied by local Desktop Commander retirement.
